USMLE-style practice · Pharmacology

Aspirin allergy

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A patient with a documented aspirin allergy asks whether bismuth subsalicylate is completely unrelated to aspirin because the product name begins with bismuth. Which ingredient explains why the medication requires caution or avoidance?

  1. A penicillin component
  2. A sulfonamide component
  3. A beta-lactam ring
  4. A live viral vaccine
  5. The salicylate component
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

The salicylate component

Bismuth subsalicylate contains salicylate; the brand or metal component does not remove that exposure.

Understanding the options

The salicylate component
Bismuth subsalicylate contains salicylate; the brand or metal component does not remove that exposure.
A penicillin component
This product is not a penicillin antibiotic.
A sulfonamide component
This does not explain the aspirin-related concern.
A beta-lactam ring
Bismuth subsalicylate is not a beta-lactam.
A live viral vaccine
The product is not a vaccine.
